properties.name: An Inference says how its premises support a conclusion, and reflow2 checks that it follows
properties.rationale:
Anthony, 2026-10-14: "I want to expand reflow2/flo2 to be able to do lines of reasoning, the graph is the proof, and inference steps for every design." Requirement C (accepted, "Accept A-D") asks that any design can say how its premises support a conclusion and that reflow2 checks the conclusion's status follows; the shape decision (accepted, his pick) fixes an Inference record between premises and conclusion, holding the rule, with a conclusion that has none reading exactly as before. Built in PR feat/an-inference-says-how-premises-support-a-conclusion.

CHANGED ARTIFACTS (40). New and registered here: art:inference, art:core-lib, art:test-an-inference-says-how-premises-support-a-conclusion-core, art:test-an-inference-says-how-premises-support-a-conclusion, art:reports-without-an-inference-fixture, art:test-mcp-tools, art:docs-overview, art:docs-interaction-surfaces, art:toolsnap-add-inference, art:claude-brainstorm-skill-mirror, art:claude-capture-intent-skill-mirror, art:grok-brainstorm-skill-mirror, art:grok-capture-intent-skill-mirror. Changed: art:agent-instructions, art:readme, art:derived, art:detect, art:graph, art:nodes, art:preserve, art:propagate, art:report, art:schema, art:vocabulary, art:derived-relations-are-declared-and-checked-test, art:enum-schema, art:tools-capture, art:tools-query, art:test-a-write-replies-with-a-receipt, art:derived-relations-are-served-test, art:test-every-writer-signs-as-the-caller-fixture, art:find-tools-corpus-fixture, art:writers-map, art:skills-and-tools, art:brainstorm-skill, art:capture-intent-skill, art:derived-edge-readers, art:derived-relations-declarations, art:schema-inference, art:smoke-mcp. The changelog fragment (changelog.d/an-inference-says-how-premises-support-a-conclusion.md) is deliberately NOT registered: the release cut deletes every fragment, so a registered one would become a missing artifact on main.

BEFORE / AFTER ON REFLOW2'S OWN DESIGN (con:no-gap-is-raised-for-a-conclusion-that-has-no-inference): main's committed copy at b19b49d, imported into a scratch store and read by main's release build (b19b49d) and by this branch's release build (05df969). Identical: delivery 245 delivered of 366 requirements (279 satisfied, 26 partially, 5 only by a discontinued capability, 0 inferred-only); 263 open gaps, detect_gaps byte-identical; 103 defects, the same findings by category. Two reads differ in words only: the unthreaded_cluster message, which names the traceability edges from the impact table, now lists PREMISE_OF and CONCLUDES among them (5 findings, same ids and counts); and derived_report declares 25 relations (follows, at 0) where main declared 24. graph_report differs only in served_by.binary_mtime_unix.

CHOICES MADE: the cycle is refused at write (circular reasoning has no verdict), with the refusal saying a chain of equivalences is still recorded by making each implication a statement of its own; the finding is one aggregate low-key gap, per the constraint's rule 3; a Capability premise holds when realized and checked (the delivery roll-up's leaf), an addition to the four types the brief named.

properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Built req:a-design-states-how-premises-support-a-conclusion-and-reflow2-checks-it-follows in the shape dec:an-inference-is-a-record-between-premises-and-conclusion fixed: a node type Inference (rule all / any / k_of_n, k, rule_name, warrant) between its premises (PREMISE_OF) and its one conclusion (CONCLUDES); add_inference writes it in one call; each premise's truth is read three-valued from what reflow2 already computes, and the rule is checked in the roll-up, on every blast radius (inferences: broken / weakened / unknown), on get_node (inference_reading) and in one aggregate finding (conclusion_does_not_follow). A circle through the two links is refused on every edge write. Declared as the derived relation follows.
